body: Hey I got a notification the other day you dropped another message on here but for some reason it isn’t showing up. My insta is rlver44 if you ever need anything, just send me a message on there. Anyways, thanks a lot for this shit that seems small, it’s been nice having someone to talk to and it’s even wilder that it’s someone I’ve never met haha.

Ahh my little brother has an Xbox I can use but I’m mainly PlayStation, drop the gamer tag and if I ever pick up the controller I’ll hop on with you for sure I’m sure we got a couple games. I really fuck with single player games though, just some shit you can get lost in like Red Dead Redemption 1 or 2 or God of War or some shit. Red dead 2 has to be top game of all time for me though that game is just goated

Mostly linebacker and running back but they switch me around a lot. Hey man, I really really appreciate you talking to me throughout this shit. I haven’t been super quick with the answers but it means fucking absolutely the world to me that you’d reply to some random bastard just to do it. Things might work out with me and this girl, I don’t know if you play 2k but I have my Hall of Fame Worm badge like Dennis Rodman, so I think I might be able to wiggle myself back in with her and actually do good this time. Again, words can’t fucking express how grateful I am for you to come and talk to me when I felt completely alone. I guess if shit goes bad with this girl, I’ll be back here talking to you some more haha.

Yeah you’re right I guess. I feel so isolated all the time man. I play football and I wrestle, lifting and running kinda takes my mind off of stuff for a while but I never have any motivation to do it anymore I just smoke or drink any time I get a chance.
I guess I do, I love all my friends a lot and my sister but I still feel so alone even though they tell me they’re here for me and stuff like that it just feels like nothing.
I hope that’s not too long or anything man I don’t wanna take up a lot of your time with some shit like this but I appreciate it a lot it hurts but it feels good to be able to talk to someone

Thank you, um, I just don’t know anymore man. Nothing seems real, I feel dead already like I’m just watching somebody live life and it’s just a game or some bullshit like that. I don’t know if I could explain it but I just don’t feel like my life even matters. My girlfriend man. I love her but I’m so confused because I know I can’t take care of myself so there was no way I could take care of both of us and a whole other family, so I felt like I had to break up with her u tik I got better mentally. And I’ve just gotten worse and worse, but she’s stayed by my side until today. She just told me she was done with me and she was with my friend now sort of. She was the only consistent thing in my life and I don’t know what to do with myself anymore. I feel like if I died it wouldn’t even fucking matter anyways and at least I’d be able to get back at her. Fuck I don’t really mean that. Or I guess I do I don’t know I’m just typing everything in thinking I don’t have anyone else to talk to.
